title: Top Yemeni Journalist: Saudi Arabia Could Lose Territory to Ansarallah
author: Ryan Grim
content:
Ryan Grim interviews Yemeni journalist Hussain Al-Bukhaiti on the state of the
conflict in Yemen. Al-Bukhaiti told Drop Site that Saudi-backed forces in
eastern areas of Al-Jawf are essentially driving around empty desert for the
cameras and presenting it as an advance.  
  
"They just go to an open area and keep shooting at a hill or a small mountain,
and there's no one there," he said, adding that the forces are also "sitting
ducks" for Ansarallah fighters who hold all the key high ground in the west of
the province.  
  
Albukhaiti also predicted that oil- and gas-rich Marib province will fall
"exactly like Mocha," saying it "could be easier" because Ansarallah has
already sharply limited Saudi air cover.
